checksums.name: slot_crc16_xmodem_like
checksums.formula_detail: MSB-first table CRC, poly 0x1021, init 0x0000, no reflection, no final XOR (FUN_0803b138: crc=(crc<<8)^table[((crc>>8)^byte)]); FUN_0802d140 calls it with seed 0 over RAM slot bytes [0,116). Stored u16 LE at RAM slot+116. Must compute on RAM image obtained by byte-reversing each 8-byte .sav block, not on raw file bytes.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 transfer setup to/from 0x0D000000 EEPROM; sets DMA SAD/DAD/CNT (0x040000D4 region per GBA spec), CNT enable 0x80000000, waits busy bit 0x8000, restores saved control. DAT register literals unresolved in decompiled.c, register names inferred from spec+constants.

EEPROM Read8: builds address bitstream (addr bits from descriptor+8), DMA out addr_bits+3 bits to 0x0D000000, DMA in 0x44 halfwords, reassembles 4 u16 MSB-first into buffer+6..0 reversed. One call = one 8-byte EEPROM block, block index param1.
EEPROM Write8: expands 4 u16 (64 bits)+address+start bits, DMA out addr_bits+0x43 bits to 0x0D000000, polls EEPROM ready bit (0x0D000000 &1) with timer timeout 0x88 ticks.
Verify: re-reads block via FUN_08046760 and compares 4 s16; returns 0x8000 on mismatch, 0 on match.
WriteWithVerify: up to 3 attempts of FUN_08046810 + FUN_08046984.

EEPROM type/descriptor select for size code (4 for 4Kbit path, 0x40 alternative, else fallback). Sets descriptor used for block count (+4) and address bits (+8). Literal descriptor contents not in workspace.
SetEEPROMSize(0x1000): stores 0x1000>>6=64 (block count) and calls FUN_08046698(0x1000>>10=4). Establishes 512-byte / 64-block / 8-byte geometry consistent with .sav size.
Load: FUN_08046760(block=i, RAMimage+i*8) for i in 0..count-1 (count from descriptor, inferred 64). RAM image base = manager+0x0C.
Flush/Save: for each block, read EEPROM via FUN_08046760, compare 4 s16 to RAM image, write only differing blocks via FUN_080469dc. Returns true iff no write/verify error.
Generic MSB-first CRC16 table routine, poly inferred 0x1021 by verification (table itself in ROM, not in workspace).
GameObject (FUN_080177ec singleton) -> 120-byte RAM slot; sets occupied magic and CRC at end.
RAM slot -> GameObject via paired setters; does not itself check magic/CRC (callers gate with FUN_0802d180).

Header bytes RAM+5..7 (FF FF FF) and slot padding RAM+118..119: no writer traced; may be erased/unused or written by untraced code.
